item.description: A messaging app can be a surprisingly practical home for a model interface.

item.description: Several model answers are interesting; seeing how they disagree is more useful.

item.description: A tiny predictor experiment shows how a useful bias becomes a liability on the wrong sequence.

item.title: The house should keep resolving
item.description: Redundancy becomes meaningful when you name the failures it is meant to survive.

item.title: One address for many models
item.description: A shared gateway keeps model choices from spreading through every application.

item.title: Make the archive usable
item.description: A family archive needs a convenient way back to the things it preserves.

item.title: The pause is part of the conversation
item.description: A voice pipeline has to manage the space between words as carefully as the words themselves.

item.title: Pictures are a kind of translation

item.title: A setup you can explain
item.description: Automating a development environment makes its hidden assumptions available for inspection.

item.description: Why I rebuilt my homepage as a static site on my own hardware.
